content.short: imToken is a multi-chain Web3 wallet for DeFi and NFTs.
content.description: Since 2016, imToken has been regarded as one of the safest crypto and bitcoin wallets. It lets you securely manage thousands of tokens, monitor DeFi balances, flip NFTs, and earn through Ethereum-based games. You can participate in Layer 2 scaling and Eth2 staking. Developers can connect dApps to the imToken API, enabling wallet access directly from their apps. The wallet also includes a DEX and a DApp browser in a single, convenient interface.
